Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 93. Category: form. Potential Unlock.

Godly Transformation
You have begun to pull out the full potential of the god
ki inside you. The user’s hair or defining feature
becomes white and your eyes turn white.
Increase your Power by 5
Increase your Movement Speed by 45 ft.
Increase all damage die by 2 steps
1d4>1d6>1d8>1d10>1d12>2d6>etc
At the end of your turn, you lose 5 Stamina
You obtain Tier 4 when you have Tier 3 and aquire
God Ki.
